title: Highest-Paid Actors & Actresses
subtitle: A red-carpet earnings skyline for the actors and actresses at the top of Forbes' annual pay lists.

cityPreview.summary: Forbes' annual highest-paid actors and actresses lists, combined into one earnings race from 2013 to 2020.

sourceStatus: Forbes annual highest-paid actors and actresses lists
confidence: Combined Forbes highest-paid actors and actresses earnings for 2013-2020 (8 annual frames). Each figure is Forbes' published pre-tax trailing-12-month estimate in USD; the two gendered lists are merged and re-ranked by earnings. Forbes did not publish comparable lists for every earlier year, so verified coverage begins in 2013.
methodology: This StoryOps adapter combines Forbes' annual 'world's highest-paid actors' and 'highest-paid actresses' rankings into one earnings leaderboard per year, re-ranking every listed performer by their published Forbes estimate. The yearly sequence is the historical backfill, so the race chart animates real year-over-year pay movement across Hollywood; portraits are enriched from Wikipedia.

beats.title: Robert Downey Jr. leads Hollywood pay in 2013
beats.body: Robert Downey Jr. leads the combined Forbes earnings list with $75.0M. Angelina Jolie tops the actresses at $33.0M.

beats.title: Mark Wahlberg leads Hollywood pay in 2017
beats.body: Mark Wahlberg leads the combined Forbes earnings list with $68.0M. Emma Stone tops the actresses at $26.0M.

beats.title: Dwayne Johnson leads Hollywood pay in 2020
beats.body: Dwayne Johnson leads the combined Forbes earnings list with $87.5M. Sofía Vergara tops the actresses at $43.0M.
